sectionThree.heading: Built Around Energy-Sector Requirements
paragraphs: Petroleum transportation is not like other freight. Terminals, filling points and receiving sites each bring their own loading arrangements and safety requirements, so we start by understanding the product, the quantities, the pickup and delivery points, and the schedule you need to meet.

LMI has carried petroleum products for oil marketing companies, refineries and exploration operations in Pakistan for decades. Drivers are trained for the work, vehicles are inspected before dispatch, and an assured fleet network of verified trucks and drivers is ready exactly when required.
Safety is part of every movement, including pre-trip checks, protective equipment and emergency response procedures.

items.question: Which petroleum products do you transport?
items.answer: Crude oil and condensate, HOBC, HSD, MS, gasoline, furnace oil, Jet A-1, LDO and bitumen.

items.question: Can you handle regular, scheduled supply runs?
items.answer: Yes. We plan recurring lifting around your supply schedule, backed by an assured fleet network ready exactly when required.

items.question: Do you move cargo from Karachi to other cities?
items.answer: Yes. We transport petroleum products from Karachi to destinations across Pakistan.

items.question: How is safety managed on petroleum transport?
items.answer: Through a strict HSE policy: trained drivers, vehicle inspection and pre-trip checks, protective equipment, emergency response procedures and incident reporting, in line with ISO 9001 standards.

items.question: How do I request a quote?
items.answer: Tell us the product, quantity, pickup point, destination and timeline, and our team will recommend a transportation approach.
